entities.name: Evan
entities.description: One of the two friends in this conversation, a married father who lives near a beach and grew up on a small island. Watercolour painting is his main outlet and he took classes in it from August 2023; he is a keen hiker, skier and road-tripper who drives a Prius. He met a Canadian woman in Canada in early August 2023, married her in December 2023 and announced her pregnancy that month. Across 2023 he had heart palpitations, a twisted knee, a second knee injury playing basketball, a hospital health scare and the loss of his job in a downsizing. He loses his keys most weeks and cannot resist ginger snaps.

entities.name: Sam
entities.description: The other friend in this conversation. His weight is the thread running through it: a bad check-up in May 2023, friends mocking him in July, a doctor calling his weight a serious health risk in October, and an ER visit for gastritis the same month. He started a diet and exercise routine on 21 August 2023, took a cooking class, took up kayaking, morning running and hiking, and became a Weight Watchers coach in his group in November 2023. He writes a journal and does creative writing, keeps meaning to take up painting, and has recurring dreams of flying over skyscrapers and recurring trouble with supermarket self-checkouts.

entities.name: Evan's wife
entities.description: The Canadian woman Evan met on a trip to Canada in the week before 7 August 2023, described at first as his new SO and later as his partner and wife. He married her in the week before 26 December 2023, they told their extended family on 5 January 2024, and she was pregnant as of 9 December 2023. She is never named in the conversation; referred to as 'this awesome Canadian woman', 'my new SO', 'my partner', 'the woman from Canada' and 'my wife'.

properties.aliases: the Canadian woman, Evan's new SO, Evan's partner

entities.name: Evan's son
entities.description: Evan's son, never named. He hurt his ankle in a soccer accident on 12 August 2023 and Evan took him to the doctor; it was nothing serious and the ankle was improving three days later. He fell off his bike on 12 December 2023 and was on crutches but recovering. Evan has more than one child and plays basketball with them.

entities.name: Sam's father
entities.description: Sam's father, never named. He took Sam hiking when Sam was ten years old; they hiked a good distance and Sam remembers it as great fun, really special for the two of them, and a great memory.

entities.name: the friend who got Evan into painting
entities.description: An unnamed friend of Evan's who introduced him to watercolour painting a few years before May 2023. On 18 May 2023 Evan said the friend got him into it and gave him advice; on 19 August 2023 he said the friend gave him a painting that inspired him, and that this was when he started painting.

entities.name: the Rocky Mountains
entities.description: The mountain range Evan and his family visited on the trip he described on 18 May 2023, hiking the trails there in the week before. On 27 August 2023 Evan said he had taken a road trip up to the Rocky Mountains in the previous month and found the scenery stunning. Referred to as 'the Rockies' and 'the Rocky Mountains'.

entities.name: Jasper
entities.description: The destination of the family road trip Evan took over the weekend of 20-21 May 2023, driving the Icefields Parkway past glaciers and lakes and staying in a cosy cabin surrounded by mountains and forests. Sam had never been there as of 24 May 2023.

entities.name: Banff
entities.description: Where Evan went skiing, as he confirmed on 19 August 2023, saying the snow was amazing and he could not wait to go back the next year. Evan's family also has a trip to Banff behind the 'Bring it on Home' sign in their memory collage.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: Where Evan travelled in the week before 7 August 2023 and met the Canadian woman he later married; where the two of them took a hiking and biking vacation shortly before 13 August 2023; and where they planned to go in February 2024 for their honeymoon, to ski, eat local food including poutine, and see the snowy landscapes.

entities.name: Lake Tahoe
entities.description: Where Sam and a friend went to kayak on 14 October 2023, having heard it was great for kayaking. Evan called it an awesome pick with clear water and gorgeous views.

entities.name: Evan's favourite spot by the beach
entities.description: A peaceful place by the beach close to Evan's home, where he often goes to relax and unwind and where watching the waves and the sunset colours helps him find peace during tough times. He photographed a sunset there on Friday 3 November 2023, and he and Sam agreed on 9 November 2023 to visit it together the following month.

entities.name: the island where Evan grew up
entities.description: A small island, never named, where Evan grew up and which he calls his happy place. On 21 November 2023 he said it shaped him, will always hold a special place in his heart, and feels like a little slice of paradise, serene and calming.

entities.name: Weight Watchers
entities.description: The weight-loss programme Sam belongs to. He was made a coach in his group by 9 November 2023, which he called a big accomplishment and a great step in his quest for better health, and he attended a meeting on 4 December 2023 that he found really insightful.

entities.name: Sam's cooking class
entities.description: A cooking class Sam started by 15 August 2023 to learn how to make healthier meals. He said it was packed with healthy recipes, that he had learned some awesome ones, and he offered to share them with Evan, including a roasted vegetable recipe.

entities.name: Evan's painting classes
entities.description: Painting classes Evan started a few days before 19 August 2023 to find like-minded people and improve his skills. They cover watercolours, and the instructor stresses observing nature and painting what you see; Evan finds them a relaxing break from everyday stress and, as of 19 August 2023, they were the only classes he was taking.

entities.name: painting
entities.description: Evan's main hobby and stress-buster, taken up a few years before May 2023 after a friend introduced him to it. He paints watercolour landscapes, favours nature subjects, paints what is on his mind, and exhibited a contemporary figurative painting in December 2023. Sam repeatedly considered taking it up, from May 2023 onwards, and still only sketched occasionally by December 2023. Referred to as painting and watercolour painting.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: An activity both men value. Evan hiked the Rocky Mountain trails in May 2023, hiked in Canada in August 2023, and says a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes motivates him. Sam hiked with his father at the age of ten, had not hiked for ages as of May 2023, and took his friends on an epic hiking trip on 29 December 2023; the two of them repeatedly agreed to hike together.

entities.name: skiing
entities.description: One of the winter activities Evan enjoys, along with snowboarding and ice skating. He skied in Banff and wanted to go back the following year, and planned to ski in Canada on his February 2024 honeymoon. Sam said in August 2023 that it looked like a blast but he was not sure his body could take it.

entities.name: kayaking
entities.description: Suggested by Evan to Sam on 14 October 2023 as a fun, active way to paddle on a river or lake; Sam and a friend went kayaking at Lake Tahoe the same day, and the two planned a kayaking trip together. Evan himself kayaked and watched the sunset on the water in the summer of 2023 and called it unforgettable.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: Recommended by Sam to Evan on 5 December 2023 as something gentle for stress relief and flexibility, having done wonders for Sam's own flexibility and stress levels. Evan said he would try it, and by 10 January 2024 said it had helped him with stress and staying flexible; he also recommends it to Sam as a low-impact exercise.

entities.name: Sam's writing
entities.description: How Sam expresses himself: journalling and creative writing, which he finds therapeutic, a way to sort out his feelings and make sense of things, and like having a conversation with himself.

entities.name: Sam's weight
entities.description: The health problem at the centre of Sam's story. A check-up a few days before 24 May 2023 showed his weight was not good; friends mocked it on 21 July 2023; a doctor told him on 2 October 2023 it was a serious health risk that could get worse; and by December 2023 he said it was affecting his confidence and keeping him from fully living. He responded with a diet from August 2023, a cooking class, Weight Watchers, morning running, hiking, and a meal plan and workout schedule begun on 10 January 2024.

entities.name: Sam's gastritis
entities.description: Diagnosed after Sam went to the emergency room with a severe stomachache over the weekend of 14-15 October 2023. He found it alarming and took it as a wake-up call to adopt a more nutritious diet and exercise regularly.

entities.name: Evan's knee injury
entities.description: Evan twisted his knee on Friday 25 August 2023, leaving it painful and interrupting his fitness routine; he planned physical therapy and swam to stay active in the meantime. He hurt the knee again playing basketball with his children in the week before 6 October 2023, by which point physical therapy had helped some and he was doing easy exercises rather than intense workouts.

entities.name: Evan's new Prius
entities.description: The Prius Evan bought to replace his old one, first mentioned on 18 May 2023 when he had just returned from a family trip in it. It broke down by 5 December 2023, which was a stressor because he relies on it for his active lifestyle and road trips, and on the weekend of 30-31 December 2023 he took it on a long drive to the mountains and had a minor accident on the way back.

entities.name: Evan's old Prius
entities.description: Evan's previous car. It broke down before 18 May 2023; he decided to have it repaired and then sell it, and replaced it with a new Prius.

entities.name: Evan's 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar
entities.description: A vintage guitar Evan received as a gift from a close friend and showed Sam on 9 November 2023.

entities.name: Evan's fitness watch
entities.description: A smart fitness watch Evan uses to track his progress towards his health goals; he says it works well as a constant visual reminder to keep going. Sam considered ordering one like it on 7 August 2023.

entities.name: The Great Gatsby
entities.description: The novel Evan was reading in the summer of 2023. He described it on 27 July 2023 as a gripping new mystery novel he could not stop thinking about, named it on the same day, and said on 27 August 2023 that it got better with every page. Sam said he would read it sometime.

entities.name: The Godfather
entities.description: The film Sam watched on the night of 9 January 2024, which motivated him to keep up his routine; he quoted 'I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse'. Evan called it a legendary thing to watch that can be rewatched many times.

entities.name: Evan's contemporary figurative painting
entities.description: A contemporary figurative painting Evan finished a few days before 17 December 2023, emphasising an emotional state through expressive brushwork and vibrant colour and capturing a moment of introspection. He was very proud of it, and a close friend helped him get it published in an exhibition.
